findings.claim: UNVERIFIED on Windows: the broken-copy swap only fires when path.normalize(resolved.id) is string-equal to realModule. On macOS (including a symlinked $TMPDIR) and by design on Linux this holds, but lab.json declares windows support, and path.normalize only rewrites separators and dot segments, never letter case. If Vite's resolved id and the config's import.meta.url-derived path differ in drive-letter case on a Windows learner's machine, the swap never applies, the wrong-label/wrong-km runs pass, and Task 7 false-fails a correct learner with 'both of your tests must fail'. No Windows host was available to confirm or refute this.

evidence.section: Node.js path.normalize, retrieved 2026-11-10T06:37:57Z: https://nodejs.org/api/path.html#pathnormalizepath - replaces separators with the platform separator and resolves '.'/'..'; the docs describe no case normalization.

Scratch run on macOS (darwin, Node 24.2.0, Vitest 4.1.12) from a /var -> /private/var symlinked path: swap applied, so all four correct variants passed and all six wrong variants failed. Windows not exercised.

findings.recommendation: Make the comparison robust (for example compare fs.realpathSync.native() of both paths, case-folded on win32, or match on path.relative(starterDir, id) === 'format-distance.mjs'), or record a Windows solved run before claiming windows in lab.json.

items.note: Executed in scratch copy $TMPDIR/pep-rf-sme/fetch-and-browser-client (npm ci in starter/, npm test from starter/; Node 24.2.0, Vitest 4.1.12). Shipped starter: 7/7 fail with the lab.json failingTests names, task 7 reporting the missing file. Private completion plus a two-test format-distance.test.mjs: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 9 passed, matching expected/on-completion.txt. Reasonable correct alternatives pass 9/9: describe+it with namespace import; formatDistance(5) whole-object toEqual with reordered keys; extensionless aliased import ('./format-distance'); toStrictEqual plus a loop over a case table. Wrong variants each fail task 7 with a specific message: no call to formatDistance; self-referential expectations; only one test; toBe on km instead of label (wrong-label caught by 1 of 2, message 'expected 1 to be 2'); a wrong expected label; a syntax error ('your test file must load'). Nested runs left no files outside starter/node_modules (.vite-task7-real, -wrong-label, -wrong-km, .vite-temp); only the learner file was added. Grading leaks no solution: the broken sources are wrong implementations and the shipped formatDistance is already public. Vitest reporter onTestRunEnd(testModules, unhandledErrors) and children.allTests() usage matches https://vitest.dev/advanced/api/reporters (retrieved 2026-11-10T06:37:57Z).
